description: County-level FRED series with every ALFRED real-time vintage: Census resident population, BEA per capita personal income, personal income, GDP and real GDP, QCEW private establishments, and the LAUS annual averages (unemployment rate, unemployed, employed, labor force). Subjects are geo:US:county:<SSCCC> with codes from GeoFRED's published geography. Each row carries the vintage it was published in and whether it is a first release, so a first-release county panel can be built without reading a revised level.

source.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED/ALFRED)
source.originating_source: U.S. Census Bureau (Population Estimates Program); U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (Personal Income by County, GDP by County); U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (QCEW, LAUS)
source.license_notes: FRED API Terms of Use (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/terms_of_use.html). The underlying series are US federal statistics (public domain); FRED terms govern API use. Cite FRED, the Census Bureau, BEA and BLS. No third-party copyright series are included.

sampling.reason: A 100-row excerpt of one series would carry a handful of vintages and could not be told apart from a current-vintage download, which is the exact confusion this dataset exists to remove. pipeline.py refuses to run on anything but the full sharded artifact.

acquisition.description: One FRED API series/observations request per configured county series (31,452: population 3,139; per_capita_personal_income 3,134; personal_income 3,134; gdp 3,113; real_gdp 3,113; private_establishments 3,142; laus_unemployment_rate 3,233; laus_unemployed 3,148; laus_employed 3,148; laus_labor_force 3,148), each over the full real-time window 1776-07-04..9999-12-31 so every ALFRED vintage comes back as [realtime_start, realtime_end] spans. Series and their county codes are discovered by build_config.py from FRED release catalogues and GeoFRED; the series_id list here must equal config.json (build_config.py --emit-parameters regenerates it). A series FRED does not archive answers 400 "does not exist in ALFRED" and is recorded as skipped. desired_bytes is the sampled size estimate plus 25% margin.
